document.title: Pip's Idiom Nest
document.description: A friendly nest where children learn English idioms and ask curious follow-up questions.

home.title: Come learn idioms with Pip!
home.lead: An idiom is a playful phrase that means something special, not exactly what the words say. Hop the idiom challenge together, or ask about a funny idiom you heard. Curious questions help your brain grow!
home.challengeTitle: Help Pip hop the idiom path
home.challengeBody: Each stone teaches one new idiom. Every few hops Pip finds a little tree, and every ninth stone a brighter birdhouse.
home.placeholder: Try “piece of cake” or “break the ice”
home.pickerTitle: Or ask about an idiom you found

path.lead: Hop with Pip from the first idiom to the last. A quiz stone sits before each birdhouse, and one last test waits after the final idiom. You can open the stone Pip is standing on, and the stones already behind.
